headline.text: L1 mixer contaminated with apron material at 06:31 — production paused, rewash in progress, *3 pallets* of L1 pistachios on hold after quarantine breach.

per_plant_summary.L1: L1 ran caramel on Sollich 3 with a Russell finex clog cleared in 37 minutes. Sollich 4 hit recurring motor overheating every 2–5 minutes; Theegarten techs onsite, line paused mid-shift. Sollich 2 discovered apron material in the mixer after clean — rewash required before restart.
per_plant_summary.L2: L2 ML3 had temper and flow wrap issues through 2nd shift, all cleared by 03:23. ML2 ran with film puncture stops, maintenance replaced rails at 04:27 and line resumed. FFS ran steadily, minor 10-minute stop for cleaning.
per_plant_summary.L3: L3 ML4 had sensor, coder, and packaging issues across all three shifts — most resolved but box coder still being worked. Truffle Line Cavanna 1 motor failed at 01:05, replacement installed at 03:19 but faulting persisted into dayshift; level 2 clean started 06:24. ML1 Bosch down since 05:10, maintenance unable to repair. MFM halted due to printer belt speed mismatch.

resolved.title: S2 matrix photo eye alarm faulting every 3 minutes
resolved.summary: C11 and C12 matrixes shutting off repeatedly; alarm would not reset, stopping all matrixes.
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 01:59 — maintenance found C12 photo eyes out of adjustment and corrected (Joseph Scott).

resolved.title: S3 Russell finex clogged, unable to drain
resolved.summary: Filter clogged during run; maintenance confirmed blockage, stopped line to clean before pin could break.
resolved.resolution: Unclogged at 01:28, tempering to resume — "The Filter was unclogged, just getting tempering" (Luis Falcon).

resolved.title: ML3 temper spiked out of range, line stopped
resolved.summary: Temper ran high at 20:32; adjustments made in wrong direction, line stopped to correct, some doubles and triples produced.
resolved.resolution: Back in range and running at 21:04 — "Temper is in range" (Mathew Draper).

resolved.title: ML2 film punctures on bottom, line down
resolved.summary: Getting punctures at vacuum; maintenance found loose chain and bent pins on fingers, inspected rails for sharp edges.
resolved.resolution: Line up at 04:27 after replacing two rails — "So far no more tears" (Gustavo Rodas).

resolved.title: ML3 scale overpacking boxes at 877 pieces vs. 800 target
resolved.summary: New operator pressing hand on box during weighing; retrained on procedure and scale adjusted to hit target count.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 19:36 — operator retrained, weight reduced to target (Mathew Draper).

resolved.title: ML3 flow wrap roller coming out of place
resolved.summary: Operator noticed roller for one of the FW plates loose; maintenance replaced bearing to secure.
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 03:23 — "Maintenance replaced the bearing. Roller is no longer moving" (Gustavo Rodas).

resolved.title: ML3 temper unit low-temperature alarm on scraper
resolved.summary: Operators turned off sweco to replace lid, idled pump and scraper; scraper temp dropped below 35°C minimum on restart.
resolved.resolution: Reheat completed, tempering again at 06:15 — "Temper unit is tempering again" (Gustavo Rodas).

resolved.title: ML4 depositor 1 door sensor broken
resolved.summary: Sensor on one of the depositor 1 doors reading molds broke; line down at 12:41 for replacement.
resolved.resolution: Depositing at 13:12 — temporary sensor installed, will not detect drip pan until replacement arrives (Shawn Jewkes).

resolved.title: ML4 gondola down, pusher hitting bowed tray
resolved.summary: All 3 TGs had issues at 14:52, monitoring system not on; gondola pusher hitting bent tray, tip blocks missing.
resolved.resolution: Running again at 16:18 — replaced bent tray, maintenance reinstalled tip blocks (Tyson Fausett).

resolved.title: Truffle Line Cavanna 1 brush arm came loose twice
resolved.summary: Brush arm on Cavanna 1 came loose at 19:16, over 30 bins of accumulation; maintenance tightened bolts on back end.
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 19:29 — "Maintenance had to tighten up the bolts on the back end" (Tyson Fausett).

needs_attention.title: S4 rear belt motor overheating every 2–5 minutes
needs_attention.summary: Motor driving rear belt stops when it overheats, takes 2.5–5 minutes to restart, discarding ~7 lb caramel each time; Theegarten techs onsite troubleshooting drive parameters.
needs_attention.status: Line paused at 16:39, TG techs to return later for more troubleshooting; replacement motor ordered, no ship date provided as of 13:50.

needs_attention.title: S3 quarantined pistachio material poured onto line
needs_attention.summary: Quarantined pallet mistakenly brought to line at 04:00, one full box poured before caught; 3 pallets of finished product placed on hold pending QA evaluation.
needs_attention.status: Three pallets isolated for QA review as of 06:17.

needs_attention.title: S2 mixer contaminated with apron material after clean
needs_attention.summary: Piece of production apron found inside mixer during post-clean inspection; mixer already cleaned for next product, must be rewashed and sanitized before production can start.
needs_attention.status: Additional pieces still inside mixer as of 06:35, rewash in progress, QA inspection required before release.

needs_attention.title: ML3 flow wrap stopping repeatedly after restarts
needs_attention.summary: Flow wrap down at 20:14 for multiple issues; after maintenance work, wrapper continues stopping itself every few seconds when restarted.
needs_attention.status: Still stopping as of 21:50 (end of 2nd shift), described as "no se ha podido correr adecuadamente."

needs_attention.title: Truffle Line Cavanna 1 motor belt failed, faulting after replacement
needs_attention.summary: Cavanna 1 belt unable to move at 01:05, suspected motor; motor replaced by 03:19 but alarms persisted, still having issues through dayshift.
needs_attention.status: Switched to Cavanna 2 at 02:14, alarms cleared at 05:50, but Cavanna 1 still down at 06:13 — "Cavanna is running" but context suggests issue ongoing.

needs_attention.title: ML1 Bosch down, maintenance unable to fix
needs_attention.summary: Bosch packaging unit down at 05:10; maintenance assessed and reported they are not able to fix at this time.
needs_attention.status: Still down as of 05:10, running only to Cavanna, Bosch not repairable by maintenance.

needs_attention.title: MFM double-head printer belt speed mismatch, line stopped
needs_attention.summary: Borrowed double-head printer from L1 for Hershey product requiring two-side print; belts lack speed to send box through printers, no motorized solution available.
needs_attention.status: MFM stopped at 21:30, producing WIP without lot code on cases; Rose directed no MFM run on Aug 4.

needs_attention.title: ML4 box laser coder down, maintenance working overnight
needs_attention.summary: Line down at 22:56 for laser coder on end packaging; 12 bins of accumulation, maintenance still adjusting code through 3rd shift.
needs_attention.status: QA approved code and accumulation passing at 02:40, but "still working on printer" updates continued through 01:44.

needs_attention.title: ML4 TG5 metal detector blowoffs, seal and vacuum issues
needs_attention.summary: TG5 experiencing frequent blowoffs on S40 setting at 03:19; maintenance also addressed metal detector blowoff, film sealing, and vacuum cleaner problems on machine 5.
needs_attention.status: Seal tested good at 03:32, but blowoffs and blue band causing chocolate to fall as of 05:15.
